program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(true, is_bos@i & is_a@i & is_b@i & is_bos@j | !is_a@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & h1_1@j | is_a@i & h1_1@i & h1_1@j, !is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j)
accept = !is_bos & h2_1 | is_a & !is_b & h1_1 & h2_1

output accept
